'''Chapter 96''' is titled "Greatest Evil of the East".{{Sort}}

==Cover Page==
[[Diary of Koby-Meppo]], Vol. 12: "Morgan's Escape".

With the terrified [[Helmeppo]] in tow, [[Morgan]] makes his escape on a spare dinghy.

==Short Summary==
After taking back their [[navigator]], the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are making a stop in [[Loguetown]] before heading to the [[Grand Line]]. In this town, [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] was executed, starting the Great Pirate Era. Luffy decides to see for himself the execution platform while the others go shopping. On his way, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] bumps into an awkward [[Tashigi|Marine girl]] who is the spitting image of [[Kuina]].

Meanwhile, the [[Marines]] have decided to put a [[bounty]] of {{B}}30,000,000 on Luffy's head. The world starts to know about his exploits. Elsewhere, [[Dracule Mihawk|Mihawk]] visits [[Shanks]] and informs him of the bounty.

==Long Summary==
[[Nami]] argues that the [[newspaper]], and everything else, has become expensive. In the meantime, [[Usopp]] develops a new chili marble to blind opponents. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] bumps into Usopp, causing him to spill the chili in his eyes. Luffy attempts to eat an [[Foods#Mikan|mikan]] from Nami's tree but [[Sanji]] defends the tree from Luffy. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], on the other hand, is resting. The [[Going Merry|ship]] heads towards the [[Grand Line]].

Meanwhile, at [[Marineford|Marine HQ]], [[Marine Ranks#Lieutenant Commander|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Brannew]] is reviewing every [[East Blue]] [[pirate]]'s [[bounty]]. Every pirate with a high bounty in East Blue has been defeated by Monkey D. Luffy. Brannew shows Luffy's first bounty of {{B}}30,000,000. The [[Marines]] are gathered to make a vow of righteousness and [[justice]] in the [[Blue Sea|sea]].

Back to the [[ship]], Luffy is proud of his first wanted poster but Nami is afraid that everybody will try to kill. Usopp is also proud of his [[Pirate Captain|captain]]'s wanted poster because the back of his head is shown. They decide it's time to head for the Grand Line. When Zoro sees an island, Nami informs them it is [[Loguetown]], "the town of the beginning and the end", where the legendary [[Gol D. Roger|Gold Roger]] was born and executed. When the crew arrives on the island, Luffy decides to head to the execution platform, Sanji looks for [[Foods|food]], Usopp wants to buy some tools and Zoro thinks of buying something, which leaves Nami offering to lend him some money with 300% interest.

While Zoro walks around the town, he sees a [[Tashigi|girl]] getting picked on by [[Koze and Packy|two pirates]] because their captain got captured by her [[Smoker|commanding officer]] and they cannot fulfill their dream to go to the Grand Line. The girl, being a [[Swordsman|swordswoman]], quickly finishes them off but drops her glasses in the process. Zoro is impressed by her skills and helps her find her glasses. When the girl thanks him, Zoro stares in shock, as she is the splitting image of his long dead friend, [[Shimotsuki Kuina|Kuina]].

In the meantime, on an isolated island, [[Dracule Mihawk|Mihawk]] is looking for someone. That someone is soon revealed to be [[Shanks]], The Red-Haired captain of [[Red Hair Pirates]]. Mihawk informs Shanks about Luffy's first wanted poster and that he remembered a story that he told him once about a kid in a little village. Shanks, eager to meet Luffy again, throws a party to celebrate Luffy's arrival and first bounty.

Meanwhile in Luffy's hometown, [[Foosha Village]], everybody is happy because Luffy is infamous. The villagers wonder if he is going to become a great pirate from the village. The [[Woop Slap|mayor]] of the village, however, is not really happy of the outcome, saying that it is Luffy's dream or destiny.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] gets his first [[bounty]], which is {{B}}30,000,000.
**Nami realises that with Luffy's newly-gained infamy, they can no longer remain in the East Blue.
*[[Marineford]], the island holding [[Marine Headquarters]], is first revealed.
**The [[World Government]] is mentioned for the first time in the [[One Piece (Manga)|manga]].
**[[Marine Ranks#Lieutenant Commander|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Brannew]] is introduced.
*The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] arrive in [[Loguetown]], the birthplace and deathplace of [[Gol D. Roger|Gold Roger]], and the final stop in [[East Blue]] before the [[Grand Line]].
*[[Tashigi]] is also introduced.
**She has a strong resemblance to [[Shimotsuki Kuina|Kuina]], much to [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]'s surprise.
*[[Shanks]] and [[Dracule Mihawk|Mihawk]] seem to know each other quite well.
*This is the first chapter of the [[Loguetown Arc]].
